lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in a grid-like configuration along the medial-lateral axis posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a rectilinear pattern across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A primary longitudinal ridge is visible along the superior flank, defined by a distinct brightness gradient transition between the dorsal and lateral surfaces.

other_distinctive_markers: A cluster of approximately 4-6 smaller, dark, fusiform objects are visible in close proximity to the ventral surface, inferior to the primary pectoral fin.
